title: Grateful Dead Live at Aarhus University on 1972-04-16
lineage: CDR > EAC(secure) > Cool Edit(see notes) > mkwact(seekable)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy set 2 with a priceless Truckin’ jam captured on a clean soundboard recording
ai_review.review: The reviewer raves about the second set, especially the extended Truckin' jam and its outro, calling it "priceless". The soundboard source is described as a great version with clear guitar work, though the vocal harmonies are noted as slightly off.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review but it is enthusiastic (5 ★) and praises both performance and recording, leading to a high rating with low confidence due to limited sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls it a "Great Version" with clear guitar; no major audio complaints, only minor note about off‑key harmonies.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Set 2 is highlighted as a classic jam‑heavy segment; the reviewer urges listeners to check out the rest of the set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for the "wha, wha" guitar finish on Truckin'
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals/harmonies noted as off during the performance
